specific_user_problem: Owners lost left navigation context when scrolling long dashboard modules due to static desktop override
design_decision: Restored single-document scroll with sticky desktop rail (position: sticky; top: var(--host-nav-offset)+12px) and persistent collapse toggle
observation: Sidebar stays pinned at top 96px across 800px scroll and persists collapse across reload

specific_user_problem: Owners had to hunt for access/privacy settings separately from publishing confirmation
design_decision: Integrated clear 3-option Visibility & Access radio selector (PUBLIC/PRIVATE/PASSWORD_PROTECTED) and Share Atelier directly inside PublishReview + Step 4
observation: Users pick privacy and confirm publication in one progressive modal flow

specific_user_problem: Small or hidden interactive targets and unstyled password gate inputs at 320px/390px mobile widths
design_decision: Minimum 44px controls on password reveal toggle, Studio share buttons, nav tabs, and mobile triggers; fluid padding preventing horizontal overflow
observation: Zero horizontal overflow at 320px and tappable bordered controls

specific_user_problem: Unstructured checklist and post-publish share links overwhelmed Step 4 completion
design_decision: Grouped publishing readiness checks, access modes, and grouped share actions (QR Card + Copy/Web Share + Telegram/WhatsApp + Unpublish)
observation: Cohesive Share Atelier grid with distinct primary/secondary/danger tiers

specific_user_problem: Owners risked publishing PASSWORD_PROTECTED invitations without a saved server password hash
design_decision: Mirrored server password-requirement guard inside publishReadiness.js + PublishReview inline validation while preserving saved hash state cleanly
observation: Confirm publication remains disabled with inline alert until valid password or saved hash exists

specific_user_problem: Slow 600-650ms entrance animations delayed initial readable paint on Landing Hero and blended semi-transparent colors at hydration
design_decision: Accelerated functional timings to 120-240ms and Hero FadeContent to 0.12s while keeping 700ms strictly for ceremonial invitations
observation: Hero copy renders crisp & accessible immediately (axe violations reduced from 9 nodes to 0)

specific_user_problem: Guests page white pills and ErrorState pink banners broke visual grouping in dark mode
design_decision: Eliminated late-chunk hex resets in GuestWorkspace.css and mapped ErrorState.css/ConfirmDialog.css to semantic surface/danger tokens
observation: Unified obsidian botanical cards and dark-mode error states with 0 axe errors

specific_user_problem: Before-state flat white chrome, cropped card placeholders, and unstyled public password gate reduced perceived trustworthiness
design_decision: Introduced Atelier Executive Rail contrast, subtle elevation shadows, object-fit contain for SVG placeholders, and styled protected gate card
observation: Zero placeholder distortion and immediate legibility across both modes

specific_user_problem: Washed-out dark mode CTA (#b7d2b8) blended primary actions into muted backgrounds
design_decision: Paired burnished champagne gold primary CTA (#d8b875) with deep obsidian ink (#14221d) in dark mode while keeping destructive actions clearly soft-crimson
observation: Primary CTAs stand out clearly with >9.6:1 contrast

specific_user_problem: After confirming publication, hosts only saw a plain URL text string
design_decision: Replaced Step 4 result with Share Atelier: live scannable QR card, SVG export, Telegram/WhatsApp/Web Share handoff, and safe Unpublish confirm
observation: Complete celebration-ready share handoff cleanly respects reduced-motion

specific_user_problem: Stale sessionStorage access tokens caused confusing 403 loops; untranslated password errors appeared on Khmer UI
design_decision: Cleared invalid sessionStorage access tokens on 403, localized 403/429 alerts cleanly, and gated Publish success strictly behind API confirmation
observation: Status text matches actual server outcome and exposes truthful retry/recovery

specific_user_problem: Khmer typography risked ascender clipping and mixed untranslated password gate errors
design_decision: Preserved 1.8 Khmer line-height, avoided English uppercase forcing on Khmer, localized guest password & rate-limit errors in Khmer & English
observation: Khmer headings & errors render cleanly across 320px-1440px without clipping

specific_user_problem: Sticky headers could obscure focused controls and Framer Motion could bypass user reduced-motion outside CSS transitions
design_decision: Added scroll-padding-top matching sticky header height + MotionConfig reducedMotion='user' wrapping app tree + CSS reduced-motion rules
observation: Focus never hides under fixed headers; drawer Escape cleanly restores focus
